Advocate Hon'ble Shri Justice Narendra Kumar Vyas Order on Board 04.11.2024 1

. The petitioners have filed the present contempt petition under Article 215 of the Constitution of India read with Section 12 of the Contempt of Court Act assailing non-compliance of the order dated 04.04.2024 (Annexure - C/2) passed by this Court in WP(C) No. 1067/2024 by which this Court has directed the respondents to conclude the land acquisition proceedings and pay the amount of compensation to the petitioners within a period of 6 months from the date of receipt of copy of order.
2.

Learned State counsel on instruction would submit that the Water Resources Department has already given the money to the Land Acquisition Officer, now the proceeding has to be initiated under the Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 which is a time scheduled programme.

3. Let the proceeding be initiated and completed within an outer limit of 6 months and the outer limit provided under the statute of Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: Since the respondents are in process of comply with the order passed by this Court, nothing is required to be adjudicated by this Court at this juncture, however, liberty is granted to the petitioners to challenge the award before the appropriate forum if they are not satisfy with the same.
5. With this observation and direction, the contempt petition is disposed of with aforesaid liberty granted in favour of the petitioners.

6. It is made clear that if any authority try to defeat the object of the Land Acquisition,
Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 or delay the land acquisition proceedings, this Court may take suo moto contempt proceeding against the erring officers.
